title: Signed metadata integrity scanner and guided remediation for SAML 2.0 setup
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Build an interactive scanner integrated into the SAML 2.0 setup flow that validates signed IdP/SP metadata, surface signature issues, cryptographic algorithm concerns, certificate rotation status, and produces guided remediation steps for admins. The scanner must run both in 'dry-run' preflight mode and in live ingestion mode, produce explainable validation results for the Console UX, and emit structured audit events for downstream logging and incident playbooks. Nonfunctional requirements: scan should complete within 3s for typical metadata sizes, tolerate large unsigned comment blocks in XML, be resilient to clock skew, and not leak raw IdP certificates to telemetry. Acceptance criteria: (1) metadata validation covers signature chain, algorithm strength (rejects SHA1-signed anchors), cert expiration/rotation heuristics, entityID canonicalization; (2) Console shows a prioritized remediation checklist and actionable commands (cURL/IdP steps); (3) audit log events include validator verdict, failing checks, operator id, and remediation suggestion; (4) a canary rollout to 5% of new SAML setups with feature-flag guard and fallback to legacy ingest; (5) unit and integration tests and a security review signed off.
comments: 2025-02-04 - Kickoff: scoped MVP to signature validation + cert expiration + algorithm heuristics. Chosen to defer attribute mapping checks to ENG-100240 to keep scope small.

2025-02-10 - Design review with PM/UX: Console will show 'Fix me' card with both automated fixes (where safe) and manual steps. Decided to include suggested command lines for common IdP consoles (Okta, Azure AD). UX asked for clear customer-facing language rather than raw XML errors.

2025-02-18 - Security sync: rejected automatic key-swapping actions. Tool will only recommend; any change that could alter trust must be admin-initiated. Added telemetry policy: only hashed cert fingerprints and validation enums sent to telemetry; raw certs must remain in customer-config store.

2025-02-25 - Implementation note: using an internal 'saml-parse' library for XML canonicalization to avoid XML signature pitfalls. Added tolerant canonicalization path for anchors with extra comments. Performance profiling shows canonicalization as the dominant cost; exploring native bindings for critical path.

2025-03-03 - Integration: added audit event schema draft (console-2025.04/audit-schema-v2). Events include 'validator_run', 'check_result' and 'remediation_click'. Need audit retention config discussion with compliance.

2025-03-10 - QA: found a clock-skew false positive when IdP certificate validity starts in future (NTP drift). Temporary fix: allow +/- 5m window and surface explicit warning in UI. Added follow-up ENG-100245 to add server-side NTP monitor.

2025-03-12 - Code review: PR #2784 opened for validator core and CLI helpers. Requesting design approval from UX to finalize remediation copy. Noted one dependency: backend feature flagging (ENG-99777) must be enabled in staging before canary rollout.
